articles.title: Canucks Begin Six-Game Road Trip in Carolina on Thursday Night
Hughes, Siegenthaler Absent, Poirier Practices | NOTEBOOK
Evangelista meets his dad's favorite hockey player Resch

away.summary: The Canucks are projected to start Kevin Lankinen in goal for this game, coming off a 7-2 loss to the Hurricanes. They will be without scratched forwards Brendan Gallagher and Guillaume Brisebois, plus injured Thatcher Demko (hip) and Filip Chytil (shoulder). The team did not practice Friday after the Hurricanes loss and is beginning a six-game road trip.

home.summary: The Devils are projected to start Nico Daws in goal, with Jake Allen also available. They will be without scratched Remi Poirier and injured Connor Brown (lower body), Johnathan Kovacevic (upper body), and Nick Bjugstad (upper body). Jonas Siegenthaler and Jack Hughes were absent from Thursday's practice but are questionable for Saturday, with Siegenthaler improving and Hughes on a maintenance day.
